title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Fizzy Cherry Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Fizzy Cherry Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit blends sweet cherry notes with a playful sparkling edge. The flavour opens with bold, ripe Cherry, rich and ruby-like, followed by a light effervescent twist that adds brightness and texture. It’s a well-balanced vape that delivers a sweet, sparkling cherry flavour with a gently balanced finish. Each 2ml pod is filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and is designed exclusively for use with the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The pods click into place magnetically and work with the dual-pod twist system for seamless flavour switching. With two pods in every pack, Fizzy Cherry is a vibrant flavour option that pairs well with cola, citrus or ice-based profiles.
